Retail Payment Platform

A complete M-Pesa STK push integration for a Nairobi retailer, handling thousands of daily transactions with real-time reconciliation.

ClientPlaceholder Client Ltd
Year2025
ServiceCustom Software · M-Pesa Integration
Live View Project

The Problem ​

The client was processing M-Pesa payments manually — checking Mpesa messages, updating a spreadsheet, then fulfilling orders by hand. At low volumes this worked, but as orders grew the process became error-prone and slow.

They needed payments to flow directly into their order management system without manual intervention.

What We Built ​

We integrated Safaricom's Daraja API to handle STK push payments directly from the checkout page. When a customer pays, the system confirms the transaction automatically and updates the order status in real time.

  • STK Push triggered at checkout
  • Instant payment confirmation via callback
  • Automatic order status updates
  • Custom merchant dashboard for transaction history and reconciliation
  • Daily summary reports sent to the business owner via email

How it looks ​

The Process ​

We started with a two-hour discovery call to map out the existing payment flow and understand what the order management system looked like. From there we scoped the integration, built it over three weeks, and ran a two-week testing period before going live.

"Payments now just work. We don't think about them anymore." — Client

Results ​

  • Payment confirmation time reduced from 5–10 minutes to under 10 seconds
  • Zero manual reconciliation errors since launch
  • Order fulfillment speed improved significantly
